sources.description: Composite WHAM+VTSS+SHASSA H-alpha map, 6 arcmin FWHM, HEALPix Nside=512; observed intensity, no extinction correction.
HASH planetary-nebula catalogue via VizieR V/163; Galactic T/L/P objects with published H-alpha flux when available.
D. A. Green Galactic SNR catalogue (2024 October / Green 2025), VizieR VII/297; identity, ICRS position and angular size only. Radio flux is not used as an optical-signal proxy.
Pinned AstroPlanner target identity/geometry layer used to define extended-source apertures.
